title: Cloud Security: billing correction
content:
Cloud Security billing correction is governed by these handling clauses.

## Calculation and source basis

For source subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect.

This gate is inapplicable to other source subtype values.

Correct an erroneous charge to the approved review net amount plus tax amount, following the tax basis.

Compare that corrected gross amount with the source original gross amount less cumulative correction credits plus cumulative debit adjustments; do not include service-credit concessions in this correction comparison.

Credit the positive overcharge, debit the positive undercharge, and make no write when equal.

A credit amount is negative and its net and tax components preserve the source proportions except an approved tax correction.

An upward correction carries positive amount.

Return the existing adjustment when the reviewed target has already been achieved.

No cash refund is implicit in an invoice correction.

Link original source event reference to the original charge and related evidence reference to the approved review, never to a broad invoice containing several lines.

Use cumulative gross correction credit less debit adjustments from the exact-source credit accounting for the correction comparison; prior pretax service credits never change the approved corrected billing target.

The correction comparison includes only posted credits and upward adjustments through the frozen handling time for the exact original source charge.

The cumulative gross correction component is the absolute amount of correction credits less upward adjustments, including tax. Unrelated source charges are excluded.

### Authoritative eligibility 1

Before the applicable credit, debit adjustment action, authoritative system records must establish: For source subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect. This gate is inapplicable to other source subtype values. The evidence is bound to the same Security event reference, original source event reference, related evidence reference.

## Basis Q&A

**Do outage concessions change the corrected billing target?**

Use cumulative gross correction credit less debit adjustments from the exact-source credit accounting for the correction comparison; prior pretax service credits never change the approved corrected billing target.

## Correction and concession

Hypothetical inputs: the original gross charge is USD 100, prior correction credits are USD 10, debit adjustments are USD 4, and the approved corrected gross target is USD 80. The current correction comparison amount is USD 94, producing a further correction credit of USD 14. A separate outage concession does not alter that comparison.
